```mjs title=main.mjs
import { __webpack_require__ } from "./runtime.mjs";
import * as __rspack_external_fs from "fs";
import { readFileSync } from "fs";

var __cjs = (factory, module) => function __require() {
	if (module === undefined) {
		module = { exports: {} };
		factory.call(module.exports, module, module.exports);
	}
	return module.exports;
};
var require_cjs_consumer = /*#__PURE__*/ __cjs(function(module, exports) {

/*!**************************!*\

// to go through init fragment path instead of raw_import_stmts
const fs = external_fs_namespaceObject
exports.g = fs.readFileSync

});

// NAMESPACE OBJECT: external "fs"

});

  }
});


// fs?fa25

// ./esm-consumer.js
// ESM module importing fs namespace - will be scope-hoisted (Concatenated)



// fs?94de

// ./cjs-bridge.js
// ESM bridge that re-exports from a CJS module
// This module is ESM but its dependency is CJS, so the CJS module
// and its dependencies (including fs) won't be scope-hoisted


// ./index.js

it('should not have duplicate import identifiers from mixed scope-hoisting', () => {
	expect(__rspack_external_fs).toBeDefined()
	expect(cjs_consumer_0.g).toBeDefined()
```

```mjs title=runtime.mjs
// The require scope
var __webpack_require__ = {};

// webpack/runtime/define_property_getters
(() => {
__webpack_require__.d = (exports, getters, values) => {
	var define = (defs, kind) => {
		for(var key in defs) {
			if(__webpack_require__.o(defs, key) && !__webpack_require__.o(exports, key)) {
				Object.defineProperty(exports, key, { enumerable: true, [kind]: defs[key] });
			}
		}
	};
	define(getters, "get");
	define(values, "value");
};
})();
// webpack/runtime/has_own_property
(() => {
__webpack_require__.o = (obj, prop) => (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, prop))
})();
// webpack/runtime/make_namespace_object
(() => {
// define __esModule on exports
__webpack_require__.r = (exports) => {
	if(typeof Symbol !== 'undefined' && Symbol.toStringTag) {
		Object.defineProperty(exports, Symbol.toStringTag, { value: 'Module' });
	}
	Object.defineProperty(exports, '__esModule', { value: true });
};
})();

export { __webpack_require__ };
```
